hostprotocol.title: HOST PROTOCOL
hostprotocol.credits.line2: Attention. You have been designated a test subject.
hostprotocol.credits.line3: The identifier will be assigned by the system.
hostprotocol.credits.line4: You have entered the Host Protocol world.
hostprotocol.credits.line5: This world was discovered by accident. It is itself an error.
hostprotocol.credits.line6: The virus infects blocks, creatures, and reality itself.
hostprotocol.credits.line8: Your task: explore the world, find the source of infection, and eliminate the virus.
hostprotocol.credits.line9: You have one hundred days. If you fail, your body stays here without you.
hostprotocol.credits.line10: Protocol active. Good luck… if that word still means anything here.
hostprotocol.materialize: Materialization. Subject loaded into the world.
hostprotocol.materialize.subject: Materializing subject %s
hostprotocol.command.replayintro: Intro reset. Materialization will play again.
